description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases for git svn garbage collection (gc) operations, utilizing functions from an external script lib-git-svn.sh. It sets up a Subversion repository, performs operations like imports, checkouts, property modifications, and then runs garbage collection, verifying outcomes at each step.

methods.description: A function assumed to execute Subversion commands.

methods.description: A function to define a test step expecting success, used for automation testing.
